name: xz-3b1efb04-blind18
instr:
# xz: locating 18 behavioural regressions without a test suite

The repository has received 18 separate undocumented edits.

This is a program for squeezing files down and getting them back again, together with the library that does the real work behind it, and it now misbehaves in a great many places at once. Nothing about the file formats changed and nothing about the callers changed, yet data that goes in no longer comes back out, calls that should refuse bad input accept it, and work that should go through is turned away.

Making compressed data out of something. Compressing a buffer in a single call, into one self-contained unit, returns output that does not restore to the input, and that same call also reports that the destination has no room when the destination is amply large; the sizes handed to it are not honoured. With one of the filters meant for executable machine code in the chain, and room for output measured to exactly the finished length, the work stops short: the last bytes are never written and the call signals that more output space is needed. Compressing ordinary text at the default setting produces a stream that restores to something other than the original data. Starting a compressor for the compact headerless variant, with ordinary literal, position and dictionary settings, fails outright with a bad-options error.
